It does not assess symptoms, recommend treatment, or determine coverage or assistance eligibility. Confirm availability, charges, network participation, and authorization with the clinic and plan for the specific service.

以城市或邮编找社区医疗机构，再向机构确认接诊和费用安排。: Locate community health centers by city or ZIP code, then confirm appointments and payment arrangements.
这份流程适合安排日常、非急诊的首次就诊。目标是拿到一个保险网络、地点、时间和材料: Use this process for a first routine, nonemergency visit. Aim for an appointment where the network, location, time, and documents are all settled. For a medical emergency, call 911. If unsure where to seek care, use your plan’s medical advice line for professional guidance rather than waiting through routine scheduling.
准备保险卡正反面、会员号码、计划完整名称、保障开始日期，以及卡上是否已指定 PC: Have both sides of your card, member number, full plan name, coverage start date, and any assigned PCP or medical group. Share them only with the clinic or plan.
登录会员门户，找 Provider Directory、Member Servi: Find the provider directory, member services, and benefits in your member portal. If you only have an employer enrollment email, ask the benefits team the date your coverage starts.
写下成人或儿科、希望使用的语言、能到达的城市和可约时段；需要无障碍或陪同安排也一: Note adult or pediatric care, preferred language, reachable cities, and available times. Include accessibility or support-person needs.
先问保险方：“我的具体计划在湾区使用哪个网络？是否必须先选 PCP 或 medi: Ask which Bay Area network your exact plan uses, whether you must select a PCP or medical group, and what referrals or authorizations apply to specialists, labs, and imaging. Acceptance of an insurer’s brand alone is not enough. Record the date, representative, or reference number, then proceed on the answers from both the practice and the plan.
第二步：从保险目录筛三家，再逐家打电话: Step 2: shortlist three practices from your plan directory, then call each
按地点、年龄范围与语言筛选，再用诊所官网找预约联系方式。给每家记三栏：是否网络内: Filter by location, age range, and language, then use the practice website for scheduling contacts. Track network status, new-patient acceptance, and earliest offered appointments separately. A PCP is your routine-care contact; a medical group is a provider organization, and not every doctor in the same hospital building is in your network.
打给诊所的预约模板: A script for calling a practice
您好，我刚搬来，想建立［成人／儿科］基层医疗关系。我的计划完整名称是［名称］，卡: Hello, I have just moved here and want to establish adult/pediatric primary care. My full plan name is [name], and my card lists [PCP/medical group, if any]. Does this provider at this location accept my specific network? Are new patients accepted? What is the earliest appointment, and is there a cancellation list? Must I change my PCP or obtain a referral or authorization? How do I arrange [language] interpretation?
旧金山示例：从 UCSF Primary Care 找地点和预约: San Francisco example: find a UCSF primary care location
先查地点，再问具体医生收不收新病人、收不收你的保险；预约请求需要诊所明确回复日期: Find a location, then ask whether the specific doctor takes new patients and your insurance. A request needs a definite date and time from the clinic.
南湾示例：使用 SCVMC 官方电话目录: South Bay example: use the SCVMC phone directory
预约与咨询列为 888-334-1000；账单和财务协助另有号码。拨打前复核目录: Appointments and advice are listed at 888-334-1000. Billing and financial assistance have separate numbers. Recheck the directory and choose the relevant department.
第三步：预约和保险两边都要问到答复: Step 3: get answers from both scheduling and your plan
预约台给出时间后，记下医生姓名、门牌、现场或视频、new patient vis: Write down the provider, address, in-person or video format, new-patient visit type, arrival instructions, and cancellation rules. Ask what a quote includes and whether membership or facility charges apply; such charges are not universal. Ask your plan what you will pay for this visit rather than treating scheduling as a coverage guarantee.
需要专科时，分别追踪 referral 是否发出、所需 authorizatio: For specialty care, track referral submission, any required authorization, and confirmation that the receiving clinic can schedule. Ask both sides for submission dates, delivery channels, and missing items. “Referral sent” is not yet an appointment; ask the providers how your current care continues.
第四步：把就诊材料准备成一页索引: Step 4: organize records for the first visit
带诊所要求的身份证明和保险资料；提前问旧病历、近期报告与影像如何安全传送，是否需: Bring the identification and insurance documents requested by the clinic. Ask how to securely send prior records, reports, and images and whether release authorization is required.
整理药物、非处方药和补充剂名称及剂量，另记已知过敏、主要担忧和三个问题；不要按攻: List medicines, over-the-counter products, and supplements with doses, plus known allergies, concerns, and three questions. Do not change medicines based on this guide.
事先申请具体语言的口译；就诊后用自己的话复述下一步，问清结果如何通知、复诊怎么约: Request interpretation in the specific language needed. After the visit, repeat the next steps in your own words and ask about results, follow-up booking, and after-hours contacts.
约不到：让保险方协助找名额: If appointments are unavailable, ask the plan to help
保存打过的诊所、日期、拒收原因与最早可约日，交给 Member Services: Keep a log of practices, contact dates, reasons for refusal, and earliest offers. Ask member services to locate an appropriate provider. Other locations, cancellation lists, or video visits may be options, but a clinician should decide what fits your needs; do not switch the type of care just to wait less.
预约时限不是指定医生的空位承诺: Access standards do not reserve a named doctor
DMHC 对适用计划公布非急诊基层医生 10 个工作日、专科 15 个工作日等标: DMHC publishes standards including 10 business days for nonurgent primary care and 15 for specialists for applicable plans, with documented clinical exceptions. Ask the plan or DMHC whether they apply, how urgent your case is, and whether you need a sooner visit. These standards are not a medical judgment that it is safe for you to wait that long.
查看 DMHC 预约标准和求助渠道: Check DMHC appointment standards and help
先联系计划；解决不了时向 Help Center 提供尝试记录和当前阻碍。: Contact your plan first; if unresolved, give the Help Center your contact log and explain the obstacle.
还没有可用保险：同时问保障申请与接诊费用: Without usable coverage: ask about enrollment and care costs
从 Covered California 的 Find an Enroller: Find free enrollment help by area and language through Covered California. Explain your current coverage and move so a counselor can check options, effective dates, and documents. Separately, ask nearby HRSA-listed health centers about new-patient registration, payment, and assessed financial assistance. The directory only lists centers; ask the center itself about cost and eligibility.
按城市或邮编找社区 Health Center: Find a community health center by city or ZIP code
记录可到达的地点，再问预约、材料、语言和费用；网上没显示名额时向机构问新病人登记: Choose reachable locations, then ask about scheduling, documents, language, and charges. Ask the center about new-patient registration if availability is not shown online.
费用：把估算、EOB 和正式账单分开: Costs: separate estimates, EOBs, and provider bills
有保险时问 copay、deductible 与 coinsurance 如何适: Ask how copays, deductibles, and coinsurance apply, including separate tests or imaging. If uninsured or not using insurance, ask the provider about a written Good Faith Estimate for the planned services. There is no universal visit price, and an estimate is not a final bill.
收到 EOB（Explanation of Benefits）时核对姓名、服务日: Check the name, service date, items, and plan processing on the EOB. CMS explains that an EOB is not a bill. Compare it with the provider invoice and ask about corrections, pending insurance submissions, and follow-up dates. Keep both records rather than relying on a screenshot of the total.
网络、授权或账单问题解决不了时: When network, authorization, or billing problems remain
先向计划提交对应问题的 grievance 并保存回复。DMHC 通常要求先走计: File a grievance with the plan and keep its response. DMHC generally requires the plan process first; follow its instructions if unresolved after 30 days or if dissatisfied with the response. Urgent health issues have immediate-help options. DMHC first checks whether it regulates your plan and redirects other plans. Use formal authorization for assistance rather than sharing a portal password.
流程和材料都在这里；Help Center 电话 1-888-466-2219。: The process and evidence list are here. The Help Center number is 1-888-466-2219.
